 Victoria Hernandez Jesse Yomtov USA TODAY Updated Nov. 17, 2026, 7:42 p.m. ET Argentina and Costa Rica face off in a friendly on Tuesday in Cordoba, Argentina as the World Cup runner-up continues to find its footing without Lionel Messi for the first time in two decades .
 The Argentines lost 2-1 to Uruguay in a friendly on Friday, Nov. 13 in Buenos Aires, with Julian Alvarez scoring the team's only goal. Costa Rica's last match was a 2-0 friendly loss to Ecuador on Friday in Quito.
 Argentina goalkeeper Emi Martinez is set to start Tuesday after recovering from the injury he suffered that required jaw surgery while playing for Chelsea on Oct. 16.
 "Maybe he was fit for the previous match, but it was a risk, and since we trust Gero (Geronimo Rulli), Juan (Musso) and Santi (Santiago Beltran), we chose to look after him. An extra three days was a prudent choice," Argentina manager Lionel Scaloni said.
 Where to watch Argentina vs Costa Rica game 
 Time: 6 p.m. ET
 Channel/streaming: ViX ( Watch on Prime Video )
 7:42 pm ET Share this update 78' Goal! Argentina notches another one
 Argentina is playing to the whistle.
 With about ten minutes left in regulation, Alexis Mac Allister, Argentina's lone starter remaining on the pitch, sent a pass and then got the ball back, dribbled around two defenders and struck the ball in for a goal.
 Argentina is up 6-0.
 7:33 pm ET Share this update 70' Argentina's momentum slowing down
 After a fiery first half and a quick second half goal, Argentina has slowed down after the break and seems to be settling into the win.
 Lionel Scaloni has substituted out nearly his entire starting lineup and, when his side has they ball, they casually dribble around instead of race to the goal.
 7:13 pm ET Share this update 48' Goal! Third Argentina player gets in the mix
 Argentina wasted no time after the halftime break getting back in action.
 In the 48th minute, Franco Mastantuono scored a goal after coming off the bench to start the second half. He took a pass while he was framed by a defender on each side, dribbled and struck the ball into the right corner of the net for the score.
 He is the third Argentina player to score and the side is up 5-0.
 7:08 pm ET Share this update Second half underway
 Argentina and Costa Rica are back on the pitch. Both sides made a few substitutions at the break.
 Nico Paz and Julián Alvarez, who have scored all of Argentina's goals so far, were taken out as was Agustín Giay. They were replaced by Franco Mastantuono, José Manuel López and Gonzalo Montiel.
 For Costa Rica, Aarón Salazar, Kenyel Michel and Andrey Soto were taken out. Douglas López, Josimar Alcócer and John Ruiz came on in substitution.
 6:57 pm ET Share this update Half: Argentina 4, Costa Rica 0
 Argentina is up 4-0 over Costa Rica at the half in their friendly match.
 Nico Paz and Julián Alvarez have each scored a goal for La Albiceleste.
 6:48 pm ET Share this update 43' Goal! Argentina pours it on
 Argentina has scored three goals in less than 10 minutes.
 The latest is Julián Alvarez' score in the 43rd minute when he took a pass, expertly remained onside, dribbled to the net against a defender and struck the ball in. The goal is his second of the night and puts Argentina up 4-0.
 6:45 pm ET Share this update 38' Goal! Nico Paz gets brace
 That was quick.
 Only three minutes after Julián Alvarez netted Argentina's second goal, Nico Paz notches another one.
 The rising star cleared traffic to strike the ball into the net and put Argentina up 3-0.
 It's his second goal of the night, giving him a brace.
 6:42 pm ET Share this update 35' Goal! Second for Argentina
 That's another goal for Argentina!
 In the 35th minute, Julián Alvarez received a pass from the side of the goal box to where he was waiting in front of the net. He did not hesitate and smacked the ball into the goal.
 To celebrate, Enzo Fernández gave him a hug and then playfully shoved him away.
 Argentina is up 2-0.
 6:30 pm ET Share this update 27' Argentina misses free kick
 In the 27th minute, Costa Rica committed a penalty and Argentina was awarded a free kick.
 Nico Paz lined up to take the shot, but sent the ball sailing over the net.
 6:18 pm ET Share this update 8' Goal! Argentina gets on the board
 Argentina strikes first!
 Julián Álvarez dribbled around and sent a pass to Enzo Fernández, who tapped the ball behind him for Nico Paz to take possession. The 22-year-old then smacked the ball into the corner of the net.
 Argentina is up 1-0 in the eighth minute.
 6:09 pm ET Share this update 5' Argentina nearly strikes early
 Enzo Fernández almost put Argentina on the board early. In the fifth minute, he took possession of the ball in front of the net and struck it, but it flew just to the left of the goal.
 6:04 pm ET Share this update Argentina vs. Costa Rica underway
 Argentina and Costa Rica are now facing off in their international friendly in Cordoba, Argentina.
 5:58 pm ET Share this update Is Lionel Messi playing for Argentina today?
 No, Lionel Messi is not playing in Argentina's match against Costa Rica today.
 The soccer superstar announced his retirement from international play in August and played in his last match for Argentina in October, a friendly against Benin. He scored a penalty kick in the 3-0 victory.
 He won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina and is second all-time in international play with 126 goals for his national team.
 5:39 pm ET Share this update Dibu Martinez returns from injury
 Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni said goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez against Costa Rica after he recovered from a jaw fracture. Martinez underwent surgery after colliding with Everton defender Jarrad Branthwaite in Chelsea's 2-0 victory last month. He returned to Chelsea training earlier this month and was called up by Scaloni despite not having played for the Premier League club since the Everton game.
 – Reuters 
 5:37 pm ET Share this update Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni signs extension
 Lionel Scaloni extended his contract as Argentina head coach until July 2030. Scaloni, who guided Argentina to the 2022 World Cup title and two Copa America triumphs, had cast doubt on his future after Argentina’s World Cup final defeat to Spain in July, with his deal set to expire in December 2026.
 But the Argentine has agreed to new terms with the national side, extending his stay until 2030.
 “We are going to officially announce the renewal of Lionel Scaloni's coaching staff for the period from 2027 to 2030 at the helm of the Argentine National Team," AFA president Claudio Tapia told reporters. "This is a joy for everyone on the AFA executive committee, as well as for all Argentinians."
 – Reuters 
 5:13 pm ET Share this update Argentina starting lineup vs Costa Rica
 Argentina starters : Dibu Martínez; Giay, Licha Martínez, Medina, Vega; Fernández, Perrone, Mac Allister; Paz, Álvarez and Prestianni.
 5:10 pm ET Share this update Argentina vs Costa Rica odds and picks
 Argentina is a heavy favorite entering the match at -1600 to win, according to DraftKings, as of 5:15 p.m. ET.
 4:57 pm ET Share this update Costa Rica lineup vs Argentina
 Costa Rica starters : Sequeira (GK), G. Taylor, J.P Vargas, F. Calvo, A. Salazar, C. Borges, K. Michel, A. Soto, C. Mora, J. Mendez and M.Ugalde
 3:51 pm ET Share this update Where is Argentina vs Costa Rica game?
 Tuesday's friendly is being played at the Mario Alberto Kempes Stadium in Cordoba, Argentina. The national team is 13-1-1 in 15 matches at the stadium since 1980.
 3:26 pm ET Share this update When is the Copa America?
 The next Copa America is scheduled for 2028.
 3:00 pm ET Share this update Argentina vs Costa Rica history, all-time record
 Argentina and Costa Rica have faced each other seven times , with Argentina winning five of the meetings and the other two ending in a draw. Their last meeting was a 3-1 Argentina friendly win 2024.
 2:34 pm ET Share this update Argentina vs. Costa Rica prediction, pick
 Argentina should respond to Friday's setback with a full crowd behind them. Costa Rica has lost four of its last six matches, and the hosts just have too much talent.
 Prediction: Argentina 3, Costa Rica 0 
 – Rob Usry
